title: OrwellContentPlaybookTuple
description: 8-node relational tuple schema for organic content experiments and playbooks

topic.description: Core subject, thesis, or engineering decision discussed

audience.description: Specific demographic or technical cohort targeted

hook_type.description: Classification of the opening narrative mechanism

format.description: Visual or text structure (e.g. Single Post, Thread, Document Carousel, Case Study)

community.description: Specific subreddit, topic tag, or technical group

outcome.description: Observed quantitative or qualitative result (bookmarks, inbound, discussions)
